title: Senior Residents (Non-Academic)
qualification: A Postgraduate Medical Degree, viz. MD/MS/DNB/MDS, in the respective discipline, recognized by NMC/DCI/NDC or an Institute of National Importance. || Valid registration with NMC/State Medical Council/Dental Council of India (DCI). || Only candidates declared passed in their qualifying degree exam on or before the date of Interview can apply. The tenure of the qualifying degree should be completed on or before the date of Interview. || In super specialty departments, candidates possessing a relevant MD/MS/DNB qualification may also apply. || Trauma & Emergency Medicine:Post Graduate medical degree like MD/MS/DNB in Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Surgery/Orthopaedics/Paediatrics/Anesthesiology from a recognized University/Institute. || Medical Oncology/Haematology:Post Graduate medical degree like MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatrics/Radiotherapy/Pathology from a recognized University/Institute. Candidates with DM/DNB Medical Oncology/Hematology can also apply.
last_date: DM, DNB, Master of Dental Surgery, MS/MD
salary: The pay scale is Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA, as admissible under rules.
age_limit: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of Interview. || A minimum age limit is not specified in the provided notification. Age relaxation for EWS candidates is also not specified.
application_fee: The fee is to be paid by Demand Draft only, drawn in favour of "EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AIIMS, Bhopal". || Fee once remitted will not be refunded in any circumstance. || Candidates applying to more than one department must submit a separate application fee for each application.
selection_process: The notification mentions that a written test/interview will be conducted at AIIMS Bhopal-462020 (MP). Date, time and venue details will be uploaded on the Institute website in due course. The exact stages and any marks distribution are not specified in the provided notification. || Tie cases (more than one candidate with the same marks in the interview) are resolved on date of birth. The older candidate is ranked above the younger candidate. || Selected candidates will undergo a medical examination/test to ascertain medical fitness. If not found fit, the offer of appointment will be treated as withdrawn. || No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process.
